ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with high-intensity (white) localized pixel disruptions; estimated ratio of dark to light area is 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white linear streaks distributed across mid-lateral sections. Focal high-intensity circular clusters mapped to the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 82 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 12% of the visible vertical lobe extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (irregular peaks) increasing in pixel deviation towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-sloping convex curve at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast circular white pixels (barnacle scars) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips and trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional high-contrast white linear segments (rake marks) of varying pixel lengths crossing the dark ventral field of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the visible fluke surface; irregular texture and white pixel clusters at lobe tips indicating previous or current barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-plumaged avian subject (puffin-like) in flight, positioned in the background plane directly above the right fluke lobe.
